raw.name: God Stone

dictionary.lore: This magical rock is a valuable material in the synthesis of the mind enhancing Fujin's Potion. Its name comes from the holy aura it radiates. It is rare in both Elgaia and Grand Gaia. It's been reportedly found in the Cave of Malice in St. Lamia, which is difficult for an average Summoner to get to.
